summary: Richard Francis Zinter, 34, of Denver, died in a rafting accident on a 16-member private Green River trip: four members hiked back upstream to run the 'Birth Canal' section of Triplet Falls in a 9-foot paddle raft; the raft hit a rock shortly below and flipped, dumping all four; three swam to shore; Zinter briefly spotted then disappeared, his PFD and one shoe popping to the surface where last seen; body recovered ~12:30 p.m. Monday June 22 by the inter-agency water-based team and transported to Echo Park by raft
location: Triplet Falls ('Birth Canal' section), Canyon of Lodore, Green River, Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: Dinosaur National Monument search and rescue staff; Moffat County Sheriff's Office; Colorado Parks and Wildlife; Moffat County Coroner
notes: Occurrence Saturday June 20, 2015; NPS news releases June 22 and June 23, 2015; group searched ~2 hr then continued downstream for help, reporting to Echo Park Ranger Station ~11:15 a.m. June 21; river flow ~1,670 cfs; family asked donations to the KATA Foundation in Richard's name
